{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column: look for values with multiple dots
revenue_series = df['revenue']

# Find rows where revenue has more than one dot
# Use raw string to avoid escape issues
multiple_dots = revenue_series.str.count(r'\.') > 1

# Show those rows
print("Rows with multiple dots in revenue:")
print(revenue_series[multiple_dots].head(10))

# Check the unique values
print("\nUnique values with multiple dots:")
print(revenue_series[multiple_dots].unique())"}
